answer: Verifiers stake an opal bond to join a harbor of validators. Each epoch a beacon re-audits finalized blocks on-ledger; if it proves a verifier countersigned an invalid transaction, that member's opal is slashed automatically, costing more than a full epoch of rewards. A sybil attacker must post one real opal per fake identity, so his cost scales linearly with the number of forged validators while his gain stays zero, making the attack permanently negative in expected value.
